Zeraim temeim shezzeraam hare hatztzomeach mehen tahor. vaafillu bedavar sheen zaro kale. vehu shehishrishu. aval kodem hasherasha hare hen betumatan afillu bedavar shezzaro kale: 
Ochalin shemmechubbarin lechelim batlu mittorat ochel. veim nitma hakkeli hare hen mittammein betumat hakkeli hoil vehen meshammeshin tashmish etz hare hen keetz: 
Kol mashke shennitma veachar shennitma nifsad venisrach hare ze betumato leolam sheen hammashke yotze al yede hakkelev leolam. veen lemashke shennitma tohora chutz min hammayim bilvad sheim hitbil mayim temeim bemikve kevan shetztzafu me mikve alehen taharu. umatbilin chammin betzonen vetzonen bechammin veraim beyafim veyafim beraim: 
Makkel shehi melea mashkin temeim vehitbil mikketzatah bemikve lo taharu hammayim sheal mikketzatah ad sheyyitbol et kullah: 
Sheleg shennitma vehishshik miktzato leme mikve hoil vetahar miktzato tahar kullo: 
Hattemed hattame ben shennitma achar shettimdo ben shettimdo bemayim temeim ad shello hechmitz mashshiko bemikve veyithar shehare hu kemayim. mishshehechmitz hare hu keyayin veen lo tohora bemikve: 
Kedera shemmilah mashkin kegon devash veyayin vechayyotze bahen unetuna betoch hammikve ufashat harishon letuma et yado venaga bah hare ze metamme et hammashkin af al pi shehi betoch hammikve venitmet hakkedera mechamat hammashkin shebbetochah af al pi shehi betoch hammikve. hayta melea mayim hakkedera tehora sheen harishon metamme keli cheres leolam veen hammayim shebbetochah temeim mippene shehen meoravim beme hammikve. pashat av hattuma et yado venaga bah nitmet hakkedera sheen hammikve metaher kele cheres: 
Me shefichot hare hen bechezkat tuma. yardu alehen me geshamim im rabbu alehen hare hen tehorim. mechetza lemechetza hakkol tame ben bechelim ben bekarkaot. ematay bizman shekkadmu me sheficha aval kadmu me geshamim veyardu alehen kol shehu mimme shefichot hakkol tame shemmashkin temein sheyyardu lithorim metammein bechol shehu: 
Hattoref et gaggo vehamechabbes et kesuto vahare hen menattefim yardu alehen geshamim verabbu hannetifot hare rabbu me geshamim alehen vehannotfim mehen tehorin: 
Hassach shemen tahor venitma ze haadam vetaval vahare hashshemen al besaro im haya kede sichat evar katan hare hu tahor keshehaya mikkodem. sach shemen tame vetaval lo tahar hashshemen shealav ella im nishar mimmennu mashke tofeach hare hashshemen betumato veim lo nishar mimmennu kede lehatepiach mimmennu batel bemiuto:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 3: Kevar bearnu sheen hoochalin mittammein ad sheyyuchsheru. veshekkol ochel sheeno meyuchad lemaachal adam eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyeyachado leadam:

Ochel shehu meyuchad laadam bammakom hazze veeno meyuchad leadam bemakom acher bemakom shehu meyuchad bo eno tzarich machashava leyachado leadam uvemakom sheeno meyuchad bo tzarich machashava leyachado leadam veachar kach yekabbel tuma. vechol ochel shessofo letamme adam vechelim eno tzarich hechsher:

Yesh ochalin shetztzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichin machashava veyesh shetztzerichin machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher veyesh shetztzerichin machashava vehechsher veyesh sheen tzerichin lo machashava velo hechsher. ketzad. kol hoochalin hameyuchadin leadam bechol makom tzerichin hechsher veen tzerichin machashava. dagim tehorim vachagavim tehorim bechol makom vachagavim temeim vedagim temeim bakkefarim hare hen meyuchadin leadam utzerichin hechsher velo machashava. vechen chelev behema tehora shemmeta tzarich hechsher velo machashava bechol makom. veellu tzerichin machashava vehechsher. basar happoresh min hachay ben min haadam ben min habbehema ben min haof venivlat haof hattame vechelev behema tehora shechuta bakkefarim af al pi shehuchshar bishchita tzarich hechsher sheni achar hammachshava. ushear kol yarkot hassade kegon habbetzalim hakkashim beyoter vehappitriyyot vechen chagavim vedagim ketannim tzerichin machashava bakkefarim. ulshin shezzeraan livhema venimlach alehen leadam enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyachshov alehen achar sheyyittalshu shemmachshevet chibbur enah machashava. elshin shellikketan livhemto vehedichan venimlach alehen leadam tzerichin hechsher sheni achar hammachshava. vechen kol kayyotze baze. haalal im chashav alav laachila mekabbel tumat ochalin. veim lav hare hu keetz veeno mekabbel tuma. vechen haatzamot hamechubbarin babbasar vehaggidim vehammekomot harakkim min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim vehakkenafayim vehannotza vehammekomot harakkim min hatztzipparnayim umin hachartom hammuvlain babbasar tzerichin hechsher umachshava. veellu sheen tzerichin lo machashava velo hechsher. nivlat behema tehora bechol makom venivlat haof hattahor vechelev behema tehora bakkerakkim lefi shehen meyuchadin lemaachal adam en echad meellu tzarich machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher mippene shessofan letamme adam vechelim bichzayit vechol hametamme tuma chamura eno tzarich hechsher. veellu tzerichim machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher. nivlat haof hattahor bakkefarim venivlat behema temea bechol makom vehu shechashav al pachot mikkezayit aval kezayit av tuma hu:

Yisrael sheshshachat behema temea lenachri veshachat bah shenayim [o rov shenayim] hare zo mittammea tumat ochalin kol zeman shehi mefarkeset veen tzericha machashava shehare yisrael shechatah laachilat haakkum veen lecha machashava gedola mizzo veenah tzericha hechsher lefi shessofah letamme tuma chamura. shachat bah echad o shennecharah enah metammea tumat ochalin. vechen akkum sheshshachat behema tehora leyisrael veshachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim mittamme tumat ochalin kol zeman shehi mefarkeset veenah tzericha hechsher. shachat bah echad o necharah enah mittammea tumat ochalin vahare hi kishar hannevelot:

Hachotech basar meevar min hachay shel behema veachar kach chishshev alav tzarich hechsher. chishshev alav veachar kach chatacho eno tzarich hechsher mippene shemmetamme tuma chamura kinvela vechol hametamme tuma chamura eno tzarich hechsher:

Pachot mikkezayit minnivlat behema temea shechishshev alav vehishlim alav kevetza meochalim acherim en hakkol tzarich hechsher hoil ufachot mikkezayit shebbechol habbetza im hishlimo lichzayit metamme tuma chamura. vechen kezayit minnivlat behema temea shechishshev alav vehinnichah babbatzek ad shehishlim lichvetza hoil veeno metamme bemagga mippene habbatzek hare ze tzarich machashava veen habbatzek hazze tzarich hechsher hoil vechol hashshiur hazze metamme bemassa mippene kezayit nevela shebbetocho af al pi sheeno metamme bemagga hare sofo letamme tuma chamura lefichach en tzarich hechsher:

Pachot mikkezayit mibbesar hammet shehishlim alav kevetza mishshear ochalin hakkol tzarich machashava shehare batel hakkol etzel kol adam. veen hakkol tzarich hechsher mippene besar hammet shebbichlalo:
Kezayit min hammet shechippahu bevatzek hakkol mittamme tuma chamura:
Hachotech basar meadam chay lehaachilo lechelev. im chishshev alav lemaachal adam hare ze tzarich machashava veeno tzarich hechsher:

Gozal shennafal laggat umet af al pi shehaggat bammedina hare nimas baggat ulefichach tzarich machashava. chishshev alav kesheheelahu lehaachilo lenachri hare ze mittamme shehare chishshev alav lemaachal adam. chishshev alav lehaachilo lechelev eno mittamme tumat ochalim. haya ze shechishshev alav lehaachilo leadam cheresh shote vekatan hare ze tahor. heeluhu kede lehaachilo leadam hare ze tame sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 4: Kamma shiur ochalin letuma. letumat atzman kol shehen afillu shumshom o chardal mittamme shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 34)</small> "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", kol shehu. veen ochel tame metamme ochel acher o mashkin o yadayim ad sheyyihye bo kevetza belo kelippatah. vechen haochel ochalin temeim eno nifsal ad sheyyochal kevetza umechetza vezehu chatzi peras:

Hammashkin mittammein kol shehen umetammein bechol shehen. afillu tippat mashkin temeim kechardal shennaga boochalin o bechelim o bemashkin acherim nitmeu. veaf al pi chen en hashshote mashkin temein nifsal ad sheyyishte reviit kemo shebbearnu:

Kol hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya lirviit. vechol hoochalin mitztarfin lichvetza letamme tumat ochalim. ulechachatzi peras lifsol et haggeviyya. afillu chitta im kemach im batzek im teena uvasar vechayyotze beellu hakkol mitztaref:

Haor hamechubbar babbasar vehammarak vehattavlin vehaalal af al pi shemmiktzato chashav alav umiktzato lo chashav alav. miktzato pelatattu chayya umiktzato pelatattu sakkin. vehaatzamot hamechubbarot babbasar. vehaggidim vehammekomot harakkim min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim vehakkenafayim vehannotza. vehammekomot harakkim min hatztzipparnayim umin hachartom hammuvlain babbasar. kol echad meellu mittammein umetammein umitztarfin lichvetza o lechachatzi peras:
Kevetza ochalin temeim shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu enan metammeim. vechen kezayit min hammet o min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu tehorin:

Kezayit chelev vedam venotar ufiggul shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu en chayyavin alehen karet. hinnichan baggeshamim venitpechu chazru lichmot shehayu. ben letuma chamura ben letuma kalla ben leissur:
Ale betzalim uvene betzalim shehen chalulin im yesh bahem rir mishtaarin kemot shehen. veim hayu chalulin verekanim memaech et chalalan:
Pat sufganin mishtaeret kemot shehi veim yesh bah chalal memaech et chalalah:
Besar haegel shennitpach uvesar zekena shennitmaata mishtaarin kemot shehen:
Haegoz vehattemarim vehashshaked hammitkarkeshim mishtaarin kemot shehen:

Kol shettumato veshiuro shavin mitztarfin ze im ze. hayu tumatan shavin aval lo shiuran. shiuran aval lo tumatan en mitztarfin vaafillu letamme kakkal shebbishnehen. ketzad tumato velo shiuro. kegon besar hammet verekev shello. shiuro velo tumato kegon besar hammet uvesar hannevela. veen tzarich lomar sheim lo hayu shavim lo beshiur velo betuma kegon besar nevela uvesar hashsheretz sheen mitztarfin:

Ochalin temeim shiuram shave shekkol ochel tame eno metamme ella kevetza. vetumatam shava shekkol ochel tame eno metamme ella bemagga veeno metamme lo adam velo kelim. lefichach mitztarfin letamme kakkal shebbishnehen. ketzad. kachatzi betza ochel rishon vechachatzi betza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze baze hare ze sheni veim naga bitruma pesalah. kachatzi betza ochel sheni vechachatzi betza ochel shelishi shebbelalan hare ze shelishi. vechen kol kayyotze baze afillu chatzi betza ochel rishon vachatzi betza ochel revii shel kodesh shebbelalan ze baze hare hakkol revii:

Kevetza ochel rishon uchevetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze baze hakkol rishon. chillekan kol echad mehen sheni. nafal ze leatzmo veze leatzmo al kikkar shel teruma pesaluhu. naflu shenehen keechad asauhu sheni:

Kevetza ochel sheni uchevetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze baze hare hakkol sheni. chillekan kol echad mehen shelishi. nafal ze leatzmo [veze leatzmo] al kikkar shel teruma lo pesaluhu. naflu shenehen keechad pesaluhu mippene sheasauhu shelishi:
Kevetza ochel rishon uchevetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze baze rishon. chillekan ze sheni veze sheni. shehashshelishi shennaga barishon naasa sheni:

Kishte betzim ochel rishon vechishte betzim ochel sheni shebbelalan hakkol rishon. chillekan lishnayim kol echad mehen rishon. chillekan lishlosha chalakim o learbaa kol echad mehen sheni. vechen kishte betzim ochel sheni vechishte betzim ochel shelishi shebbelalan hakkol sheni. chillekan lishnayim kol echad mehen sheni. lishlosha ulearbaa hare kol echad mehen shelishi:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 5: Yedot hoochalim hen haetzim harakkin hassemuchin laochel shehaochel nitle bahen min hailan. kemo ektze hatteenim vehaagassim uketzat haeshkol. vechen haggarinim vechayyotze bahen middevarim shehaochel tzarich lahen. veshomre hoochalin hen hakkelippa sheal haochel shehi shomarto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol shehu yad veeno shomer mittamme umetamme velo mitztaref. vechol shehu shomer af al pi sheeno yad mittamme umetamme umitztaref. vechol sheeno lo shomer velo yad eno mittamme velo metamme veen tzarich lomar sheeno mitztaref. ketzad mittamme umetamme veeno mitztaref. sheim naga tuma bayyad nitma haochel hattaluy bo. veim naga tuma baochel nitma hayyad. veen hayyad mitztarefet im haochel lehashelimo lichvetza o lechachatzi peras. aval im haya shomer hare ze mitztaref lichvetza velichachatzi peras:

Keshem sheyyad letuma kach yesh yad lehechsher. sheim huchshar hayyad huchshar kol haochel hattaluy bo. veyesh yad lefachot mikkezayit. veyesh shomer lefachot mikkefol. veshomer shechilleko eno mitztaref im haochel:

Uminnayin leshomre ochalin shehen mittammein im haochel keshehen mechubbarin bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 37)</small> "al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea" kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria. chittim besaarehen useorim biklippehen vaadashim biklippehen. vehu haddin lishar hashshomrin:
Uminnayin lidot hoochalin shehen mittammeot umetammeot keshehen mechubbarin im hoochalin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 38)</small> "tame hu lachem" lechol shebbetzarchechem:
Habbotzer laggat en lo yadot shehare en lo tzorech beyad mippene shemmotzetz et hammashke:
Hakkotzer lesikkuch en lo yadot shehare eno tzarich layyad:
Kol yedot hoochalin shebbissesan begoren tehorin:

Pesiga shel eshkol sherikkenah tehora. veim nishtayyer bah garger echad hare ze yad leoto garger umekabbelet tuma. vechen sharvit temara sherikkeno tahor. shiyyer bo temara achat tame. vechen sharvit kitniyyot sherikkeno tahor. shiyyer bo garger echad mekabbel tuma:
Leolam en shomer al gabbe shomer ella shomer echad bilvad hassamuch laochel hu hannechshav immo:
Shalosh kelippot babbatzal. penimit ben shelema ben kedura mitztarefet. emtzait shelema mitztarefet kedura enah mitztarefet. hachitzona ben kach uven kach tehora:

Kol hakkelippin mittammeot umetammeot umitztarfot mippene shehen shomer. kelippe polin veturemusin zerakan enan mittammeot kenasan loochalin mittammein. veim nishar bahen ochel ben kach uven kach mittammein. kelippat melaffon af al pi sheen bahen mittoch hammelaffon mittammeot tumat ochalin. hasseorim bizman shehen yeveshin kelippatan mitztarefet immahen uvizman shehen lachin en mitztarfin. aval hachitta ben lecha ben yevesha kelippatah mitztarefet:
Kol haggarinin mittammeot umetammeot velo mitztarfot chutz miggarinot harotev. aval shel temara yavesha enah mitztarefet:
Hachotel sheal haggarina shel rotev enah mitztarefet vesheal garinat hayyevesha mitztarefet mippene shehu davuk baochel nechshav keochel:

Garina shel rotev sheyyatzat mikketzatah kol shekkeneged haochel mitztaref vehayyotze eno mitztaref. vechen etzem sheyyesh alav basar kol shekkeneged habbasar mitztaref. haya alav habbasar mitztzad echad eno mitztaref mimmennu ella haetzem shettachat habbasar ad chalal haetzem. veim lo haya laetzem chalal roin oto keillu hu koovi haezov ushear haetzem en mitztaref shehaatzamot labbasar keshomer hen chashuvin:
Kulit shehaya aleha basar afillu kefol gorer et kullah letuma:
Garine zetim utemara af al pi sheshshelakan loochalin en mittammein:
Garine charuvin af al pi shekkenasan loochalin en mittammein. shelakan loochalin mittammein:

Veellu mittammein umetammein umitztarfin. sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehen lachin. vehappitma shellahen ben lecha ben yevesha. vehaammud shehu mechuvvan keneged haochel. vesharshe hachazarin vehannafus. veshoresh tzenon gadol mitztaref. vehassiv shello eno mitztaref. vesharshe hamminta vehappegam. vesharshe yarkot sade veyarkot ginna sheakaran lishtalim. vehashshi[z]ra shel shibbolet vehallevush shellah. veuktze teenim ugerogarot. vehakkelussim vehecharuvin:

Veellu mittammeim umetammein velo mitztarfin. sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehen yeveshin. vehaammud sheeno mechuvvan keneged haochel. umalain shel shibbolim vehen hassearot hashshechorot shebberosh hashshibbolet sheddomin kemo massar. veektze haagassim vehakkerusetmalin vehapperishin vehauzeradin. veoketz delaat tefach hassamuch laochel. veoketz kundas tefach. vechen yad happarkil tefach mikkan vetefach mikkan. vehapparkil hu hassarig shehaeshkelot teluyin bo. veyad haeshkol kol shehu. uzenav haeshkol sherikkeno. veyad hammichbad shel temara arbaa tefachim. vehammichbad hu haetz haadom shehashsharvitin teluyin bo vehattemarin devukot bashsharvitin. ukene hashshibbolet shelosha tefachim. veyad kol hanniktzarin shelosha tefachim. vesheen darko lehikkatzer yedehem vesharshehen kol shehen. kol ellu mittammein umetammein velo mitztarfin mippene shehen yedot ochalin:

Veellu lo mittammein velo metammein velo mitztarfin. shear kol hookatzim. vesharshe kilche hakkeruv. vechalfe teradim vechalfe hallefet vehen haikkarin shennisharu bakkarka keshellaktu hakkeruv vehallefet vechazru vehechlifu. vechol hashsharashin sheddarkan lehiggazez shenneekru im haochel. happitma shel rimmon mitztarefet vehannetz shello eno mitztaref:

Harimmon vehaavattiach shennimmok miktzato en hannishar chibbur leoto shennimmok. veen hannishar min hakkelippa mitztaref shehare en shemirato moelet kelum. vechen im haya shalem mikkan umikkan venimmok baemtza en hatztzedadin chibbur ze laze veen kelippato mitztarefet. ale yerakot yerukkin mitztarfin ulevanim enam mitztarfin shehare enan kelum:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 6: Haegozin vehashshekedim shennisdeka kelippatan adayin hu chibbur laochel ad sheyyeratztzetz et hakkelippa:

Betza megulgelet mishsheyyikkov bah makom legamah mimmennu en shear kelippatah chibbur. usheluka kelippatah chibbur ad sheyyeratztzetz et hakkelippa. veim nittabbela biklippatah af al pi sheritztzah kullah chibbur:
Etzem sheyyesh bo moach chibbur ad sheyyeratztzetz. tzemer shebberashe hakkevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim af al pi shecharachan baur hare hen chibbur ad sheyyatchil litlosh:
Kanfe chagavim vekaskasse dagim af al pi sheheevir sakkin alehen chibbur ad sheyyatchil lekallef. harimmon sheppirdo chibbur ad sheyyakkish alav bekane:
Hashsharvitim shel temarim enan chibbur ze laze:

Melaffon shechatacho unetano al hashshulchan chibbur ad sheyyatchil lefarek. hitchil lefarek chaticha vechol haole immah chibbur vehashshear enah chibbur. pika hattachtona chibbur leatzmah veenah chibbur lachatichot. hayu shenayim o shelosha melaffonot vechatach kol echad mehen vehinnichan al hashshulchan vehitchil beechad mehen ze shehitchil bo chibbur vehashshear eno chibbur. afillu amar chetzyo ani ochel shacharit vechetzyo arvit ze hachetzi shehitchil bo chibbur vehashshear eno chibbur:

Hamechattech yerakot vechayyotze bahen levashshel af al pi shello merek vehivdil eno chibbur. ella im nitma ze lo nitma ze af al pi shehu meore bo. chatach lichbosh o lishlok o lehaniach al hashshulchan hare ze chibbur vaafillu hitchil lefarek ma shechatach:
Kol ochel sheadayin lo perko chibbur veim nitma miktzato nitma kullo:

Ochel shennifras umeore bemiktzat venaga tame beechad mehen im achaz beze shennaga bo vehashsheni ole immo hare ze chibbur. veim kesheochez baze hattame umagbiho yishamet haacher veyippol eno chibbur ella hare ze haacher kenogea barishon shennitma:

Kol hoochalin shehayu alin o kelachin mechubbarin bahen et sheddarko leheachez beale ochazin oto beale. bakkelach ochazin oto bakkelach. im nitla immo hare ze chibbur bitvul yom veen tzarich lomar bishar tumot. vechen im haya lo yad ochazin oto bayyad shello. hayta lo yad veale ochazin oto bee ze mehen sheyyirtze. lo hayta lo yad velo ale, baze amru im ochez battame vehashsheni ole immo chibbur veim lav eno chibbur:

Haegozin shekketzatzan beektzehen keshehen rakkin vaamanan kullan kemo chevel vechen habbetzalim shechibberan badderech hazzot hare ellu chibbur. hitchil lefarek baegozim ulefakkel babbetzalim en hashshear chibbur. afillu hayu lefanav mea kor en kullan chibbur shehare hochiach sheddato lefarek hakkol:
Kelia shel shum shennaflu mashkin al echad mehen hu tame vechibburo tahor sheen chibbure adam chibbur lechol davar. vechen etrog shennifrash utechavo bechush o bekesam eno chibbur:
Issa shellashah beme perot enah chibbur. sheen lecha davar shemmechabber et hoochalin ella shiva mashkin bilvad:

Hamemaech ochalin ze baze vekibbetzan kegon haddevela vehattemarim vehatztzimmukin shekkibbetzan vaasaan guf echad enan chibbur. lefichach iggul shel devela shennaflu mashkin temein al miktzato hare ze notel mimmennu mekom hammashkin bilvad vehashshear tahor:
Hattemarim vehaggerogarot sheshshelakan venaasu om hare ze chibbur:

Hazzetim sheatanan venaasu gush echad hare ze chibbur. mippene shemmittechilla lo netanan lammaatan ella al menat sheyyinku ze mizze. lefichach sheretz shennimtza al om shel zetim vehen hazzetim shennaasu kullan guf echad afillu naga bechisora hakkol tame shehakkol guf echad. hayta lo om shel zetim veatid lehafchah kevan shettaka bah et hayyated af al pi sheyyesh bah gushim harebe enan chibbur. veim mishshehafachah naasu om enan chibbur:

Ochel parud shehu kullo mechunnas vedavek ze baze af al pi sheeno chibbur lehittamme veeno keguf echad kemo shebbearnu hare hu mitztaref lichvetza letamme tumat ochalim acherim. veim lo kenaso ella hare hu meforad kemaase kedera vehakkitnit eno mitztaref ad sheyyekabbetzem veyaasem gush echad. hayu gushim harebe ze betzad ze venaga av hattuma beechad mehen hare hu rishon vehaggush shebbetziddo sheni veshebbetzad hashsheni shelishi veshebbetzad hashshelishi revii:

Kikkar shel teruma shehayta rishon letuma vehishshich lah acherot kullam rishon. persha hi rishon vechullan sheniyyot. hayta sheniyya vehishshich lah acherot kullan sheniyyot. persha hi sheniyya vechullan shelishiyyot. hayta shelishit vehishshich lah acherot hi shelishit vechullan tehorot ben sheppershu ben shello pershu:

Kikkarot shel teruma noshchot zo bezo nitmet achat mehen besheretz kullan rishon veaf al pi sheppershu achar mikkan. [nitmet achat bemashkin temein kullan sheniyyot af al pi sheppershu achar mikkan]. nitmet achat mehen beyadayim kullan shelishiyyot veaf al pi sheppershu mippene shehayu guf echad bishat tumatan:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 7:
Hannitzok eno chibbur lo letuma velo letohora. ketzad. haya meare mashkin tehorin letoch keli tame vaafillu al gabbe hashsheretz hare haammud hannitztzok tahor. veim kalat min hammashkin hanniggarin min haavir hare ze shekkalat tahor. veen tzarich lomar shehammashkin shemmeare mehen tehorin: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheera mitztzonen letzonen o mecham lecham o mecham letzonen. aval hameare mashkin tehorin tzonen letoch mashkin temein chammin hare hannitztzok chibbur venitmeu hammashkin hatztzonen kullan shehu meare mehen venitma hakkeli shemmeare mimmennu mechamat hammashkin shebbetocho shehare nitmeu. umippene ma amru hameare mashkin tzonen lechammin chibbur mippene sheeshen hachammin ole ketimrot ashan umitarev bannitztzok uvammayim shebbakkeli haelyon umetamme hakkeli sheheashan haole min hachammin mashkin hu chashuv: 
Lefichach haishsha shehayu yadeha tehorot vehegisah bikdera temea vehizziu yadeha mehevel hakkedera nitmeu yadeha keillu naga bammashke shebbakkedera. vechen im hayu yadeha temeot vehegisah bikdera vehizziu yadeha nitma kol ma shebbakkedera keillu naga bammashkin shebbakkedera: 
Nechil devash hazzifim udevash hatztzappachat hannitztzok shellahen chibbur vaafillu haya meare mitztzonen letzonen mippene sheyyesh lahen rir vahare hen nimshachin kedevek. lefichach kol hoochalin en hannitztzok shellahen chibbur vaafillu hayu avim harebe kegon haggerisin vehachelev hammuttach vechayyotze bahen. lefi sheen lahen rir. vechen shear kol hammashkin en hannitztzok shellahen chibbur ella im ken era mitztzonen lecham kemo shebbearnu: 
Hannitztzok eno chibbur letahara. ketzad. sheim era mayim temeim mikkeli even vechayyotze bahen letoch hammikve en omrim mishshehiggia ketzat hannitztzok lammikve tiharu hammayim ella hare hen betumatan ad sheyyashshik hammikve lechullan mitztzad echad kemo shebbearnu. vechen hakketafres sheyyesh alav mashke tofeach eno mechabberan lishar hammashkin shebbammidron lo letuma velo letohora. aval hammashkin shebbaeshboren kullan chibbur letuma uletohora: 
Areva shehi ketafres vealeha mashke tofeach veshalosh chatichot ochalin temeim bichvetza munnachin aleha zo lematta mizzo enan mitztarfot. hayu shetayim hare ellu mitztarfot. veim haya tachtehem mashke omed afillu keen hachardal hare ze metzaref et kullan: 
Kevar bearnu shettevul yom eno metamme chullin kelal ella posel achle teruma umashke teruma veose hakkol shelishi. vechen im naga beachle kodesh o mashke kodesh pesalan vaasaan revii: 
Yesh devarim sheenam chibbur bitvul yom veaf al pi shehen chibbur bechol hattumot. ella im naga bahen tevul yom lo pasal ella ze shennaga bo. veillu haya hannogea bimkom tevul yom adam acher haya posel hakkol. afillu haya hannogea adam sheachal ochalin temein o shata mashkin temein shehi tuma kalla hare ze pasal hakkol shello pesalo tevul yom. veen tzarich lomar sheim haya hannogea av tuma o rishon shehu metamme hakkol. umippene ma hekellu bitvul yom mippene shekkevar tahar veeno mechussar ella haarev shemesh. veod hekelu bitvul yom sheyyesh ochalin shehen meyuchadin leadam umittammein bechol hattumot vehen tehorot bitvul yom. veellu hen. hasseora vehakkussemet bizman sheenan kelufin. aval bizman shehen kelufin vehachitta af al pi sheenah kelufa. vehakketzach vehashshumeshum. nifsalin bitvul yom veen tzarich lomar shehen mittammein bechol hattumot: 
Kol yad hoochalin shehen chibbur beav hattuma hare hen chibbur bitvul yom. vechen kol haochel shennifras umeore bemiktzat shehu chibbur beav hattuma kach hu chibbur bitvul yom. vechol sheeno chibbur bitvul yom hare hu chibbur beyadayim vegam ze chomer betumat yadayim mittevul yom:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 8:
Chalot o kikkarim shekkenasan vehayu noshchot zo bezo vedato lehaferishan o sheafa challa al gabbe challa battannur vaadayin lo karmu paneha venaga tevul yom beachat mehen lo pasal ella hachalla shennaga bah. vechen hammayim shehirtichu venaasu kekubba. vehaggerisin shehirtichu reticha rishona. veyayin chadash veorez shehirtichu. venaga tevul yom barticha eno chibbur velo pasal ella harticha bilvad. uvishar kol hattumot ben kallot ben chamurot hakkol chibbur. aval challot shehayu noshchot zo bezo veen dato lehaferish. o sheafa challa al gabbe challa venashchu vekarmu battannur. uretichat hammayim sheenah mechulchelet kekubba. uretichat haggerisin sheniyya. uretichat yayin yashan. uretichat hashshemen ben yashan ben chadash. uretichat adashim. hare ellu chibbur bitvul yom veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot: 
Batzek sheyyatza bishat afiyya venimtza beemtza hakkikkar kemo masmer yotze. vechen ketzat habbatzek shennimshach venechrach beet afiyya vehu hannikra charchur. im hayu pechutim mikkeetzba venaga tevul yom bahen pasal kol hakkikkar. vechen im naga begarger melach katan shebbakkikkar nifsal kol hakkikkar. veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot. aval tzeror shebbakkikkar o turemus vegarger melach gadol vecharchur yeter mikkeetzba shennaga bahen afillu av hattuma hakkikkar tahor veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom: 
Rakik shennechrach chetzyah vechetzyah kayyam hare zo eno chibbur. nechrach haemtza vehatztzedadin kayyamin enan chibbur ze laze afillu beav hattuma veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom. besar kodesh shekkaram alav hammarak venaga tevul yom bakifa hachatichot muttarot. naga bachaticha hachaticha vechol haolin immah chibbur. vechen betavshil kitniyyot shekkaram al gabbe perusot. shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin venaga tevul yom bashshemen lo pasal ella hashshemen: 
Yarak teruma uvetza terufa netuna al gabbav venaga tevul yom babbetza lo pasal ella kelach shekkenegdo. veim hayta kemin kova eno chibbur: 
Chut shel betza shekkaram al dafnah shel ilpas venaga bo tevul yom. min hassafa ulefanim chibbur min hassafa velachutz eno chibbur. vechen bekitniyyot shekkarmu al sefat hakkedera: 
Chavit shennikkeva ben mishshuleha ben mitztziddeha vesatam tevul yom hannekev beyadav nifsela kullah: 
Hameare mikkeli lichli venaga tevul yom bakkilluach meshaarin ze shennaga bo beechad umea. shetteruma temea shennitarva beechad umea batla bemiutah kemo shebbearnu behilchot terumot: 
Tevul yom shehaya torem et habbor venafla mimmennu chavit shel teruma veshaka bevor shel yayin venaga bayyayin shebbabbor. min hassafa velachutz eno chibbur min hassafa ulefanim chibbur. veim haya habbor pitas afillu haya keli gadol shemmachzik mea kor kullo chibbur veim naga bemiktzat hayyayin pasal hatteruma shebbechavit shebbekarka hakkeli: 
Hassolet shel menachot vehallevona vehakketoret vehaggechalim shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan. bamme devarim amurim begechalim shechote bemachta beyom hakkippurim. shehammachta shechote bah nichnas lahechol. aval gechalim shechote bechol yom keshehu meare bemachta shel kesef leshel zahav im nitpazzeru min haggechalim en bahen kedushsha ella mechabbedan laamma: 
Mikpa shel chullin o rakik shel chullin veshemen shel teruma tzaf al gabbehen venaga tevul yom bashshemen lo pasal ella hashshemen bilvad. veim chibbetz kol makom shehalach bo hashshemen pasal: 
Yarak shel chullin shebbishshelo beshemen shel teruma venaga bo tevul yom lo pasal ella mekom maggao: 
Hammikpa shel teruma vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan: 
Hammikpa shel chullin vehashshemen shel teruma shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan lo pasal ella mekom maggao. im haya hashshum merubbe holchin achar harov. ematay bizman shehu gush bikara aval im haya mefuzzar bimdocha venaga bemiktzato lo pasal ella mekom maggao mippene shehu rotze befizzuro. ushear kol hanniddochin sheddarkan leduchan bemashkin kegon hashshum beshemen im dachan shello bemashkin vekibbetzan af al pi shehen gush bikara venaga bahen lo pasal ella mekom maggao. shehare hem keiggul shel devela sheim nitma miktzato lo nitma kullo: 
Issa shekkara shem challatah bitzfonah o bidromah. vechen hakkishshut shekkara shem teruma bitzfonah o bidromah hare ze chibbur. veim naga tevul yom bemiktzat haissa nifsela hachalla. nittela challatah mittochah vechazra letochah eno chibbur: 
Issa shennidmea o shennitchammetza bisor shel teruma enah nifselet bitvul yom: 
Issa shehuchshera bemashkin venillosha beme perot venaga bah tevul yom lo pasal ella mekom maggao bilvad: 
Maaser rishon shehuchshar venaga bo tevul yom o yadayim mesoavot mafrishin mimmennu terumat maaser betohora. mippene shemmaaser rishon kechullin utevul yom veyadayim mesoavot enam poslin et hachullin shehashshelishi bechullin tahor kemo shebbearnu. vechen haishsha shehi tevulat yom lasha et haissa vekotza lah challa umafrishatah umannichatah bechelim venotanto im shear haissa keachat. umakkefet al hakkol kede litrom min hammukkaf veachar kach kora lah shem veomeret hare zo challa. umishshettikra lah shem lo tigga bah shello tifselennah. vechach hi osa im lasha baareva shehi tevulat yom: 
Lagin shehu tevul yom shemmilleahu mechavit maaser shello nittela terumato veamar hare zo terumat maaser al ma shebbechavit achar shettecheshach hare zo teruma tehora. lefi sheenah naaset terumat maaser ad shettecheshach kefi tenao veachar shettecheshach yaariv shimsho shel lagin veyithar. nishbera hechavit kodem shettecheshach hallagin betivlo. nishbar hallagin hechavit betivlah: 
Tevul yom mittumat met umibbeilat nidda ose bevet habbad. vechen shear hattemeim shettavlu osin betohorot. chutz mizzav vezava bashshevii shellahen sheaf al pi shettavlu lo yaasu bevet habbad velo yitasseku betohorot shemma yiru venimtzeu temeim lemafrea shehare sotrin hakkol kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 9:
Hashemen o haddevash shennitmeu veachar kach karshu veachar kach nimmochu hare hen rishon letuma leolam mippene shehen kemashkin veaf al pi shekkafu achar shennitmeu: 
Harotev vehaggerisin vehechalav shekkarshu hare hen koochalin utzerichin machashava. veim naga bahen ochel rishon o mashke naasu sheniyyim. haya bahen mashke tofeach hare hen kemashkin vehen techilla letuma. nitmeu keshehen mashkin vekafu achar ken vekarshu hare hen sheniyyim kemo ochel shennitma mimmashkin temein. nitmeu keshehen kefuyim venimmochu venaasu mashkin im hayu kevetza mechuvvan hare hammashkin tehorin. hayu yoter mikkevetza hammashkin temein shekkeshennimmocha tippa rishona nitmet bichvetza ochel tame shennimmocha mimmennu veotah hattippa tetamme kol hammashkin shennimmochu achareha. vechen teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim shehuchsheru im hayu kevetza hare hammashkin hayyotzin mehen tehorin. uvilvad shello yigga bimkom hammashke shehammashke kemufkad baochel ucheillu hi guf acher. hayu otan zetim vaanavim yeter mikkevetza hare hammashkin hayyotzin mehen temein shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa rishona nitmet bichvetza vetimmea kol hammashkin. veim haya hassochet zav vezava vechayyotze bahen afillu sachat garger echad yechidi shello huchshar velo naga bammashke hammashke tame shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa rishona nitmet bemassa hazzav shehazzav shennasa ochalin o mashkin temein kemo shebbearnu. vechen zav shechalav et haez hechalav tame shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona nitmet bemassa hazzav: 
Kedera shemmelea kevashin shel chullin veyatzu alehem chutz lakkedera venaga av hattuma o rishon beale shechutz lakkedera bimkom hannaguv af al pi sheyyesh beale kevetza hu tame vehakkol tahor. chazar lakkedera timme et hammashkin shebbah venitmet hakkedera vechol hakkevashin. naga beale shechutz lakkedera vehaya bo mashke im yesh beale kevetza hakkol tame sheheale metamme mashke shealav vehammashke metamme kol hammashkin shebbakkedera umetamme et hakkedera. hayta hakkedera melea kevashim shel teruma venier otah tevul yom veraa mashkin al yado safek min hakkedera nittezu safek shehakkelach naga beyado hayyarak pasul vehakkedera tehora: 
Tame shehaya ochel anavim muchsharim venafal mimmennu garger yechidi laggat im haya shalem velo nishmat mimmennu ektzo haggat tahor. veim nittal ektzo vehayu anavim muchanim baavit vechayyotze bo ledarchan shehare rotze bammashke hayyotze mehen nitma haggat betippat mashke shebberosh haggarger bimkom haoketz. naflu mimmennu anavim uderachan bemakom mufene im hayu kevetza mechuvvan hare hammashkin hayyotzin mehen tehorin kemo shebbearnu. hayu yeter mikkevetza hayyotze mehen tame shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa rishona nitmet bichvetza umetammet et kol hammashke hayyotze achareha: 
Gush shel zetim temein shehaya mekubbatz umechubbar vehishlicho letoch tannur vehussak im haya kevetza mechuvvan hattannur tahor sheen hoochalin metammein kelim vehammashke hayyotze mehen tahor kemo shebbearnu. haya haggush yeter mikkevetza nitma hattannur shekkesheyyatza tippa achat nitmet bichvetza vetimmea et hattannur. lefichach im hazzetim hattemein perurin veenan gush afillu hen mea hattannur tahor: 
Etzim shennivleu bahem mashkin temein vehissikan hattannur tahor shehare batlu baetzim. vaafillu hotzi haetzim shennaflu alehen geshamim venaflu lirtzono vehissikan hattannur tahor veen hammayim shealehen mittammein min hammashkin habbeluin bahem. velo yassikem ella beyadayim tehorot gezera shello yassikem hattame venimtzeu hammashkin shealehem metammein et hattannur: 
Sheretz shennimtza berechayim shel zetim en tame ella mekom maggao. im haya mashke mehallech hakkol tame. shekkevan shennitma miktzat hammashke nitma kullo vehashshemen metamme et kol hazzetim. nimtza al gabbe healin lemala min hazzetim yishalu min habbaddadin im amru lo naganu neemanin. nimtza al om shel zetim nitma kol haggush kemo shebbearnu. nimtza al gabbe zetim perurin vehu nogea bichvetza hakkol tame shehaochel shehu kevetza metamme hammashke hameorav bahen vehammashke metamme shear hazzetim. hayu perurin al gabbe perurin vehammashke millematta af al pi shennaga bichvetza en tame ella mekom maggao: 
Am haaretz shehoshit yadav laggat venaga beeshkolot eshkol vechol sevivotav temein vehaggat kullah tehora mippene shemmafsikin haeshkolot shessevivot ze haeshkol beno uven shear haggat: 
Haggefet vehazzaggim shennaasu betohora vehalchu alehen temein veachar kach yatzu mehen mashkin hare ellu tehorin shemmitchilla naasu betohora. veim naasu mittechilla betuma veyatzu mehen mashkin temein: 
Habbaddadin shennichnasin veyotzin umashkin temein betoch bet habbad im yesh ben mashkin lazzetim kede sheyyenaggevu et raglehen baaretz hare hazzetim tehorin shehannogea bemashkin temeim shello beyadav tahor vaafillu lekodesh. kikkerot hekdesh shehayu bahen gumot uvetoch haggumot hayu mashkin shel kodesh venaga hashsheretz beachat mehen venaga rishona bashsheniyya usheniyya bashshelishit afillu mea kullan rishon letuma. mippene hammashke shebbaggummot vechibbat hakkodesh hare hen kullan kemashkin sheen monin bahen. aval im hayu kikkerot teruma hare hakkikkar hashshelishit bilvad pesula umishshelishit vahala tahor. veim haya mashke tofeach al kol hakkikkarot af bitruma hakkol temeot vechullan sheniyyot chutz min harishona shennaga bah hashsheretz shehi rishon: 
Avabua hannaase boovi hechavit vahare hu kemo keli acher betziddah im nikkav haavabua laavir hechavit venikkav nekev acher lachutz ze keneged ze. o shehaya hannekev happenimi millematta vehachitzon millemala vehaya haavabua vehechavit meleim mashkin. im naga av hattuma bammashke shebbaavabuot nitmeu kol hammashkin shebbechavit. hayta hechavit mukkefet tzamid patil unetuna beohel hammet nitmet mippene hannekev shebbaavabua ze shehare hu mefullash laavirah. vechen im haya hannekev shebbaavabua shebbifnim millemala vehachitzon millematta hare zo enah nitztzelet betzamid patil. aval im naga av hattuma baavabua lo nitmeu mashkin shebbechavit vehinnam kemuvdalin mehen:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 10:
Kevar bearnu shehashshiva mashkin bilvad hen shemmittammein o machshirin vehashshear keruyin me perot veenam mittammein velo machshirin. veshiva mashkin shemmaninu toldotehem kayyotze bahem: 
Toldot hammayim hem hayyotze min haayin umin haozen umin hachotem umin happe ume ragle bene adam ben gedolim ben ketannim kol ellu hayyotzin min haadam mashkin hen ben sheyyatzu ledato shel adam ben sheyyatzu shello ledato. aval me ragle behema vehammelach shennimchat hare hen keme perot lo mittammein velo machshirin: 
Haddam hammanuy min hammashkin hu haddam hashshotet bishat shechita min habbehema vehachayya vehaofot hattehorin. aval dam hakkilluach eno machshir sheadayin chayyim hen vahare hu dome ledam makka o ledam hakkaza. hashshochet venittaz dam al hoochalin venitkanneach haddam ben siman lesiman hare ze safek. lefichach tolin alav lo ochlin velo sorfin. toldot haddam dam hakkaza shel adam shehotzio lishtiyya aval im hotzio lirfua tahor veeno machshir. vechen dam shechita bivhema uvechayya uveofot hattemein vehaddam hayyotze im hallecha veim hari vedam hashshechin vehaavabuot vetamtzit habbasar kol ellu enan mittammein velo machshirin ella hare hen kishar me perot. vedam hashsheretz kivsaro metamme veeno machshir. veen lanu kayyotze bo: 
Me hechalav hare hen kechalav. vachalev haadam sheeno tzarich lo eno mashke lo machshir velo mittamme. lefichach chalev hazzachar eno mashke. vechen chalev behema vechayya sheyyatza shello leratzon kegon shezzav mehaddad meelav o shechalavo kemitassek. aval chalev haishsha ben sheyyatza leratzon ben sheyyatza shello leratzon setamo mashke umittamme o machshir mippene shehu rauy letinok: 
Hammashkin sheyyotzin meotan hattemein sheotan hammashkin avot tuma metammeim belo hechsher shehattuma vehahechsher bain keachat veellu hen. zov hazzav veshichvat zaro umeme raglav. ureviit dam min hammet. vedam hannidda. vechen dam maggafto shel zav vachaverav vechalav shel ishsha vedimat enayim im shear toldot hammayim hayyotzin mehen metammein kemashkin temein shemmetammein belo kavvana shemmashkin temein metammein leratzon veshello leratzon. lefichach nidda o zava shennataf chalav middadeha laavir hattannur nitma hattannur vechol ma shebbetocho: 
Kevar bearnu shehammashkin hayyotzin mittevul yom enam temeim. lefichach im naflu afillu al kikkar shel teruma eno muchshar ad sheyyippelu leratzon kishar hammashkin hattehorin sheenan machshirin ella leratzon: 
Hazzea vehallecha hasserucha vehari vehammashkin hayyotzin mibben shemona chodashim vehashshote me teverya vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheyyotzin nekiyyim kol ellu enan chashuvin mashke velo mittammein velo machshirin: 
Hashshote shear mashkin veyatzu hare hen mashkin keshehayu sheen shear hammashkin tehorin bagguf. ketzad. shata mayim temein vehekian hare ellu temein mippene shello tiharu bitziatan. shata mayim temeim vetaval veachar kach hekian [o shennisrechu veachar kach hekian] o sheyyatzu millematta af al pi shello taval hare hen tehorin. shata shear mashkin temein o shear ochalin temein af al pi shettaval veachar kach hekian temein lefi sheenan tehorin bagguf. nisrechu o sheyyatzu millematta hare hen tehorin: 
Kevar bearnu shehazzea enah mashke afillu shata mashkin temein vehizzia zeato tehora. aval habba bemayim sheuvin vehizzia zeato temea. veim nistappeg min hammayim hashsheuvin veachar kach hizzia zeato tehora: 
Zeat battim shichin umearot uvorot enan mashke vaafillu hen temein zeatan tehora. aval zeat hammerchatz bemayim im hayta hammerchatz temea zeatah temea. veim hayta tehora vehichnis bah perot huchsheru. hichnisu lah kelim hare hammayim shealehen kitlushin beratzon umachshirin: 
Habberecha shebbabbayit vehabbayit mazzia mechamatah im hayta habberecha temea zeat kol habbayit shemmechamatah temea: 
Shete berechot babbayit achat temea veachat tehora. hammazzia karov lattemea tame karov lattehora tahor. mechetza lemechetza tame: 
Hammohal kashshemen. mashkin hamenattefin missalle zetim vaanavim eno mashke velo mittammein velo machshirin ad sheyyachnisem bichli: 
Hashshokel anavim bechaf moznayim hayyayin shebbakkaf eno mashke ad sheyyearennu letoch hakkeli vahare ze dome lesalle zetim vaanavim shemmenattefin: 
Haddores anavim shel teruma bechavit af al pi shehayyayin tzaf al gabbe yadav hare hakkol tahor: 
Mashke bet mitbachayim shebbaazara vehu dam hakkadashim vehammayim shemmishtammeshin bahen sham tehorin leolam veenan mittammein velo machshirin. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. lefichach kol deme hazzevachim eno mekabbel tuma veeno machshir. vehoil vedam hakkadashim eno machshir kadashim shennishchatu baazara lo huchsheru bedam shechita veen livsar hakkadashim hechsher ella bemashkin sheyyippelu al habbasar chutz mimmashke bet hammitbachayim: 
Parat kadashim sheheevirah bannahar ushechatah vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha hare zo muchsheret. lefichach im nimtzet machat temea bivsarah hare habbasar tame. vechen im hayta happara chasuma michutz lirushalayim af al pi sheen hammachat yedua hare habbasar tame mippene shennaga bechelim hannimtzain michutz lirushalayim. nimtzet hammachat bapperesh habbasar tahor. uven kach uven kach hayyadayim tehorot sheen tumat yadayim bammikdash kemo shebbearnu. bamme devarim amurim lihyot habbasar tame bedin tora. aval lehittamme middivrehen en hekdesh tzarich hechsher ella chibbat hakkodesh machsheret habbasar. veim naga bah tuma ben kalla ben chamura nifsela af al pi shello huchshar bemashke kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 11:
Habbotzer anavim limkor bashshuk o leyabbeshan lo huchsheru letuma ad sheyyippelu alehen mashkin lirtzono kishar hoochalin. aval habbotzer lidroch huchshar letuma veaf al pi shello naflu mashkin al habbatzir kelal veim naga bo tuma nitma. vedavar ze gezera middivre sofrim. umippene ma gazru al habbotzer laggat shehu muchshar sheppeamim sheadam nichnas lecharmo leda im higgia lehibbatzer vesochet eshkol shel anavim livdok bo umezallefo al gabbe haanavim habbetzurot shehare hakkol lidricha omed. veod mippene sheeno makpid alav hare hu mitmaech veyetzu memav vahare hu makpid alehen shello yazuvu bakkarka venimtza muchshar bahen. lefichach gazru shehabbotzer legat huchshar: 
Habbotzer anavim sheim lo matza lahem shuk machaziran laggat lo huchsheru ad sheyyavou lirshut haggat. vechen hazzetim shebbau lirshut habbad huchsheru kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Habbotzer anavim unetanam beavit o sheshshetachan al gabbe healin huchsheru bemashkin hayyotzin mehen shehare dato al hammashkin ulefichach shatach al healin o natan letoch heavit shehu kemo bor lefichach im natal mehen tame o mi sheyyadav temeot timmean. batzar venatan lassallim o bemashtiach shel adama lo huchsheru shehare eno makpid al hammashke hayyotze mehen lefichach notel hattame mehen veochel veaf al pi shehen mevukkaot umenattefot laggat hare haggat tehora shehare lo huchsheru vahare nivtzeru laachila. vechen hannotel min hassallim umin hammashtiach shel adama veachal vehotir kisa uchesatayim uzerakan laggat. veaf al pi shehayyayin menattez al haanavim lo huchsheru: 
Anavim shehayu besallim o bemashtiach shel adama velakach mehen ledarchan huchsheru lefichach tzarich likkach mehen beyadayim tehorot kede shello yikkach mehen hattame vitammeen: 
Kerem shehu omed bevet happeras habbotzer oto laggat eno muchshar kol zeman shehu bevet happeras hoil vetumat bet happeras middivrehem vehabbotzer laggat huchshar middivrehem hekellu bigzera zo velo gazru alav sheyyihye muchshar ad sheyyetze mibbet happeras. lefichach harotze livtzor bevet happeras laggat betohora metaher et habbotzrim veet hakkelim umazze alehem shelishi ushevii umaariv shimshan kede lehakkir sheen mekillin betumat bet happeras ella mippene shehu safek veachar kach nichnasin uvotzrin umotziin chutz levet happeras vaacherim tehorim mekabbelin mehen umolichin laggat veim nagu ellu beellu temein metammein et haanavim shehaanashim shebbevet happeras temein umetammein leotan shebbachutz veosin oto rishon vehen metammein et haanavim shehare huchsheru mishsheyyatzu chutz levet happeras: 
Hammosek et zetav lechavshan o lemachran bashshuk lo huchsheru ad sheyyippelu alehen mashkin beratzon kishar hoochalin. vechen hammosek zetav lidroch bevet habbad lo huchsheru ad shettiggamer melachtan. umippene ma yuchsheru hazzetim shennigmera melachtan shechezkatan shehuchsheru bemohal shellahen shehare rotze bekiyyumo kede sheyyihyu nochin lidroch. aval kodem shettiggamer melachtan en hammohal hayyotze mehen machshir mippene sheeno rotze bekiyyumo. lefichach zetim shello nigmera melachtan shennaflu alehen mashkin temein en tame ella mekom maggaam kechol hoochalim shello huchsheru. naflu alehen mashkin temein achar shennigmera melachtan nitmeu kullan shehammashkin hattemein metammeim et hammohal shebbahen vehammohal metamme et kullan. shehammohal sheyyatza mehen achar gemar melachtan chashuv mashke umittamme umachshir: 
Chavit shel zetim megulgalim tzarich linkov hechavit kede sheyyetze hammohal. veim lo nikkev hare ellu muchsharin. nikkevah usetamuha shemarim vehinnam belulim bammohal enam machshirin mippene sheenan birtzono shehare nikkevah: 
Zetim shemmesakan lidricha meematay gemar melachtan mishshettiggamer mesikatan veyihyu munnachim umuchanim lidricha. af al pi shello naflu alehen mashkin velo yatzu mehen mashkin hoil venigmera melachtan huchsheru. aval kodem shennigmera melachtan af al pi shennitmaachu vehizziu venitchabberu bemashkehen enan muchsharin. gamar millimsok zetav aval atid likkach zetim acherim lehosif alehem afillu eno atid lehosif ella o kav o kabbayim lo huchsheru. veim heerim hare ellu muchsharin. gamar millikkach aval atid lilvot ulehosif veero ones o nitassek bemishte velo hosif adayin lo nigmera melachtan veenan mekabbelin tuma. vaafillu zavim vezavot mehallechin alehem tehorim: 
Haoten zetav bishne baddim kevan sheggamar achat mehen huchsheru lekabbel tuma: 
Hammassik zetav baggalil haelyon veatid lehoridam laggalil hattachton en mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyoridem lesham. vehu shechishshev alehen kodem sheyyimsok aval achar sheyyimsok en hammachshava moelet ella huchsheru. gamar et zetav veatid lemachran lo huchsheru. atid lechappotan bealin huchsheru umekabbelin tuma: 
Hallokeach maatan zetim min haakkum im yesh massik al pene haadama yeasu betuma shezze bechezkat sheggamar. veneeman am haaretz lomar maatan ze lo gemartiv: 
Harotze littol mizzetim shello nigmera melachtan velidroch hare ze notel mehen betuma umolich levet habbad betuma umechasse hashshear betuma veeno choshesh shehare lo huchsheru kede sheyyekabbelu tuma: 
Hammanniach et zetav bechotesh kede sheyyamtinu veyihyu nochim lehikkatesh hare ellu muchsharin. hinnichan sheyyamtinu vesheyyimlachem achar sheyyamtinu enan muchsharin shehare dato alehen lechavshan: 
Happotzea zetim shel teruma beyadayim temeot pesalan sheppetziatan hi gemar melachtan. petzaan lesafgan bemelach lo huchsheru. vechen im petzaan leda im yesh bahen shemen vehiggiu lehimmasek lo huchsheru: 
Hammanniach zetim baggat legargeran uleyabbeshan afillu hem rum amma enan muchsharin. netanan babbayit sheyyilku af al pi sheatid lehaalotan laggag o shennetanan baggag sheyyilku af al pi sheatid lefatcham veyafris otan hare ellu muchsharim. netanan babbayit ad sheyyishmor et gaggo o ad sheyyolichem lemakom acher enan muchsharim sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan: 
Haoten zetav birshut am haaretz venaal vechatam eno choshesh shemma yesh lo mafteach acher vechotam acher. af al pi shemmatza chotam mekulkal umafteach patuach hare ellu tehorin. vechotam sheamru afillu tzeror o kesam. hayu sham chorin usedakin eno choshesh shemma machnis kane umesitan. hayu sham challonot shel arbaa tefachim niddonot kiftachin: 
Haddorech betuma veratza letaher kele bet habbad vehaakkal min hammashkin hattemein shennivleu bahen ketzad yaase. keli shel etz veshel avanim mediach. veshel nesarim vechayyotze bahen menaggevan. veshel gemi meyashshenan kol shenem asar chodesh o choltan bechammin o beme zetim o mannichan tachat tzinnor shemmemav mekallechin o letoch mayan shemmemav rodfin shetem esre shaot. veachar kach matbil et hakkelim shetztzerichin tevila umishtammesh bahen betohora:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 12: Kol divre hechsher ochalin divre kabbala hen mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 38)</small> "vechi yuttan mayim al zera" echad hammayim veechad shear shiva mashkin. vehu sheyyinnaten alehem birtzon bealim veachar shenneekru min hakkarka. sheddavar yadua hu sheen lecha zera shello ba alav mayim keshehu mechubbar. lo neemar vechi yuttan mayim ella leachar shenneekru hoochalin venitleshu hammashkin:

Kol mashke shennafal al haochel battechilla birtzon bealim af al pi sheen sofo beratzon o shehaya sofo beratzon veen techillato beratzon hichshir. nafal shello birtzono eno machshir afillu balal hu perotav mippene hassakkana o mippene hatztzorech vehu en retzono sheyyihyu belulin hare ellu lo huchsheru. ketzad. hattomen perotav bemayim mippene haggannavim o hannoten perotav leshibbolet hannahar lahavian immo enan muchsharim:

Mashkin shennitleshu min hakkarka shello beratzon enan machshirin. lefichach adam o kelim o perot shennivlelu bemashkin shennitleshu shello beratzon af al pi shennagu ochalin beotan mashkin beratzon lo huchsheru shehare otan hammayim shello leratzon nitleshu ucheillu hen adayin bakkarka sheenan machshirin. hayu hammayim sheal haadam veal hakkelim veal happerot telushin beratzon venagu bahen ochalin beratzon huchsheru. ketzad. hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach hammayim shebbah machshirin. veim hinniach bahen perot huchsheru mippene shehen telushin bakkeli ledaat. kefaah bishvil shello yilke hakkotel hammayim shebbah enan kitlushin ulefichach im natan bah ochalin lo huchsheru. nitkavven sheyyudach hakkotel im haya kotel bayit hare ellu machshirin shehattalush shechibbero leinyan hechsher hare hu ketalush venimtzeu mayim sheal kotel bayit ze kammayim shebbakkelim. veim haya kotel meara sheeno binyan ella atzmah shel karka hammayim shealeha enan kitlushin min hakkarka:

Hashshoche lishtot hare hammayim haolim bisfamo uvefiv telushin birtzono. sheddavar yadua hu shehashshote yaale hammayim befiv uvisfatav vehoil veshata birtzono hare ellu nitleshu beratzon. aval hammayim haolim bechatmo uvizkano uverosho enan telushin beratzon:

Hamemalle et hechavit hammayim haolim achareha uvachevel shehu mechonen al tzavvarah uvachevel shehu letzarkah hare hen telushin beratzon. vehammayim shebbachevel hayyater al tzarkah enan telushin beratzon. netanah tachat hatztzinnor kol hammayim sheal gabbah uvachevel enan telushin beratzon lefichach en machshirin:

Mi sheyyardu alav geshamim afillu haya av hattuma. hammayim shealav af al pi sheyyardu mitztzad haelyon lattachton tehorin vehu sheyyenattekem mealav bechol kocho. aval im hayu shottin veyordim bishat perishatam mittammein. uvizman shehen tehorin enan machshirin shehare enan telushin alav lirtzono. veim nier hare ellu leratzon. amad tachat hatztzinnor lehaker o lidoach hare ze leratzon. veim haya tame hammayim shealav temein:
Chavit shehayta melea perot veyarad haddelef letochah hare ze yeare hammayim mealehen veenan machshirin veaf al pi shertzono sheyyihyu betochah ad sheyyeare hammayim mealehen:

Areva sheyyarad haddelef letochah hammayim hannittazin vehatztzafin mealeha enan telushin beratzon. netalah leshafchah hammayim shebbetochah enan beratzon. hinnichah sheyyered haddelef letochah hannittazin vehatztzafin shebbetochah enan telushin beratzon. veim netalah leshafchah hare ellu machshirin shekkevan shello shefachah bimkomah hare telashan birtzono:
Hammatbil et kelav vehamechabbes et kesuto bimara hammayim haolin beyadav beratzon uveraglav enan kitlushin beratzon:

Perot shennaflu letoch hammayim ufashat yadav unetalan lo huchsheru. veim chishshev sheyyudechu yadav huchsheru bammayim shebbeyadav shehammayim shebbeyadav vesheal happerot hare hen kitlushin beratzon:

Hannoten perotav letoch hammayim birtzono im hayu mayim shebbakkarkaot enan muchsharin kol zeman shehen bammayim. hotzian huchsheru bammayim shealehen o sheal yadav shehare nitleshu beratzon. ketzad. tzenon o lefet shehu betoch hammeara nidda medichattu sham vehu tahor. heelathu kol shehu min hammayim nitma bemaggaah:

Kuppa shehi melea turemusin unetuna letoch hammikve moshit yado hattame venotel turemusin mittochah vehen tehorin mippene shello huchsheru shehare mittochah natal veen retzono bammayim shealehen. heelam min hammayim hannogin bakkuppa temein shehare huchsheru bammayim shebbakkuppa shennitleshu birtzono. ushear kol hatturemusin shebbetoch hakkuppa tehorin:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 13: Hamemale bakkilon hammayim hannisharim bakkilon hare hen telushin beratzon ad shelosha yamim aval achar shelosha yamim enan telushin beratzon ella im nishar sham mashke eno machshir:

Etzim shennaflu alehen mashkin beratzon veyardu alehen geshamim shello leratzon im rabbu hare kullan shello leratzon. hotzian sheyyerdu alehen geshamim af al pi sherabbu hare kullan leratzon. hayu raglav o ragle behemto meleot tit veavar bannahar verachatzu im samach hare hammayim haolin alehen telushin beratzon veim lav enan beratzon:
Hammorid et haggalgallim veet kele habbakar bishat hakkadim lammayim kede sheyyissatmu hassedakin shebbaetz hare hammayim haolin bahen telushin beratzon:

Hammorid et habbehema lishtot hammayim haolin befiha telushin beratzon uveragleha enan kitlushin beratzon ella im chishshev sheyyudechu ragleha. uvishat hachoref vehaddayish af shebberagleha telushin beratzon. horidah cheresh shote vekatan af al pi shechashav sheyyudechu ragleha hammayim haolin beragleha enan telushin beratzon sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava:
Hattovel bemayim hare kol hammayim sheal besaro telushin beratzon. aval haover bemayim kol hammayim sheal besaro enan telushin beratzon:

Mi shettaval bannahar vehaya lefanav nahar acher veavar bo bittelu hashsheniyyim et harishonim vahare hammayim shealav enan telushin beratzon. vechen im dachahu chavero lishabbero o lishabber behemto batlu hammayim harishonim. aval im dachahu derech sechok lo batlu ella hare hammayim shealav telushin leratzon. taval bannahar veala veyardu alav geshamim im rabbu alav geshamim hare batlu mayim harishonim vahare kol hammayim shealav enan telushin beratzon:
Hashshat al pene hammayim hammayim hannittazin enan telushin beratzon. vehammayim haolin alav telushin beratzon. im nitkavven lehattiz al chavero af hannittazin telushin beratzon:
Haose tzippor bammayim hammayim hannittazin veet shebbah enam telushin beratzon:

Hammoded et habbor leda amko mayim haolin beyado uvaddavar shemmadad bo telushin beratzon. veim madad rachbo mayim haolin beyadav o bedavar shemmadad bo enan telushin beratzon. pashat yado o raglo labbor leda im yesh bo mayim hare hammayim haolin beyado o beraglo enan telushin beratzon. peshatan leda kamma mayim sham haolin bahen telushin beratzon. zarak even labbor leda im yesh bo mayim mayim hannittazin enan beratzon vesheal haeven enan kitlushin:
Hachovet al hashshelach chutz lammayim hannittazin mimmennu telushin beratzon shehare retzono sheyyetzu. chavat alav vehu betoch hammayim enan telushin beratzon:

Hammayim haolin bassefina uvaekel uvammeshotot enan telushin beratzon. uvammetzudot uvarshatot uvammichmorot enam telushin beratzon. veim nier telushin beratzon. vechen hammayim sheal hakkasya [shel] shulchanot veal hassafa shel levenim enan beratzon. veim nier hare ellu beratzon:

Hammolich et hassefina layyam haggadol letzarfah. hammotzi masmer laggeshamim letzarfo. hammanniach et haud baggeshamim laasoto [pecham]. hare hammayim shealehen telushin beratzon. aval hammotzi et hammasmer veet haud laggeshamim lechabbotan en hammayim shealehen telushin beratzon:
Shilshel et hammesholet labbor lehaalot bah keli o kiton. shilshel et hakkalkala labbor kede shetteshev aleha (et) hattarnegolet. en hammayim shealeha telushin beratzon:

Hamemachek et hakkeresha lehasir hammayim shealeha vehassochet searo bichsuto hammayim hayyotzin telushin beratzon. vehannisharin enan telushin beratzon mippene shertzono sheyyetzu mikkullan. ucheresha atzmah huchshera shebbishat perishatah machshirin. veim nittek hammayim mealeha bechol kocho lo huchshera:

Hammarid et hailan lehashshir mimmennu ochalin o lehashshir tuma hammayim hannittazin mimmenna enan telushin beratzon. hirido lehashshir mimmennu mashkin hayyotzin hare hen telushin. vehannisharin bo af al pi shennashru mimmakom lemakom enan telushin beratzon. mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo. vechen im nittezu al hamechubbarin enan telushin beratzon:

Hammarid et hailan venafal al chavero o sukka venafla al chavertah vetachtehen zeraim virakot mechubbarim lakkarka venaflu hammayim al happerot hamechubbarin shettachtehen otan hammayim shebbazzeraim veshebbayrakot enan telushin beratzon:

Shemarim shel teruma shennatan alehen mayim kevar bearnu bitrumot sheharishon vehashsheni asur lezarim veshel hekdesh bedek habbayit af hashshelishi asur. veshel kadshe mizbeach leolam asur. veshel maaser sheni havvadday rishon bilvad asur. keshem sheamru leinyan issuran kach amru leinyan hechsheran. kegon shennitmedu mealehen vehayta behema shota rishon rishon. sheim haya haadam hu shemmesir hammayim harishonim af al pi shemmealehen naflu kevan shechashavan vehikpid alehen machshirin:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 14:
Perot sheyyarad haddelof lotochan veervan kede sheyyitnaggevu lo huchsheru: 
Hammaale perotav laggag mippene hakkenima veyarad alehen hattal lo huchshar. veim nitkavven sheyyered alehen hattal huchsheru. lefichach im heelum cheresh shote vekatan af al pi shechishshevu sheyyered hattal alehen lo huchsheru sheyyesh lahen maase din tora veen lahen machashava afillu middivre sofrim. hafchu bahen ketannim al haggag hare ellu muchsharin sheim hayta machashava shel katan nikkeret mittoch maasav machshavto moelet middivrehen: 
Hammaale et haaguddot veet hakketziot veet hashshum laggag bishvil sheyyamtinu veyered alehen hattal lo huchsheru. veen omrin hoil vehakkol yodin shehattal yored hare ze birtzono shehare lo heelam ella kede sheyyamtinu: 
Hammolich chittin litchon veyardu alehen geshamim im samach huchsheru. hayu zetav netunin baggag veyardu alehen geshamim im samach huchsheru. hachammarim shehayu ovrim bannahar venaflu sakkehen bammayim veheelum im samchu huchsheru happerot vehammayim sheal hassakkin hinnam telushin beratzon shehare samchu: 
Sak shehu male zeronim venatun al gabbe hannahar o al pi habbor o al maalot hammeara veshaavu huchsheru: 
Chavit shehi melea perot shennetanah betoch hammashkin o melea mashkin shennetanah betoch happerot veshaavu huchsheru. beellu mashkin amru bemayim uveyayin uvechometz aval shear hammashkin en meshaavin min hacheres kede sheyyachshiru happerot shebbetziddan: 
Harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yayin im hayta pat chittin lo huchshera. veim hayta shel seorim huchshera mippene shehasseorim shoavot. vechen im haya hayyayin tame vehayta pat chittim tehora veim hayta seorim nitmea mippene sheshshaava mashkin temein: 
Hamerabbetz et beto venatan bo chittim vetannu. im mechamat hammayim huchsheru. veim mechamat hassela lo huchsheru. hamechabbes et kesuto baareva venatan bah chittim vetannu im mechamat hammayim huchsheru veim mechamat haareva lo huchsheru: 
Hattomen perot bachol kede sheyyartivu huchsheru. hattomen battit hannaguv im yesh bo mashke tofeach huchsheru veim lav lo huchsheru: 
Hamerabbetz et garno eno choshesh shemma yechsheru chittav im tannu bo veaf al pi shehu sameach: 
Hamelakket asavim keshehattal yored alehen lechappot bahen hachittin lo huchsheru veim nitkavvin lechach huchsheru: 
Hamerabbetz et beto bemayim temeim venatan bo shibbolim vetannu im yesh alehen mashke tofeach hare ellu temein veim lav tehorin: 
Hannoer agudda shel yarak shehayu aleha mashkin veyardu mitztzad haelyon latztzad hattachton lo huchshar: 
Hammaale sakkin melein perot min hannahar unetanan ze al gabbe ze huchshar hattachton bammayim sheyyardu lo min haelyon shehare birtzono hinniach ze al gabbe ze: 
Hannofeach baadashim levadkan im hen yafot vehizziu huchsheru behevel piv mippene shehu mittoldot hammayim. vechen haochel shumshemin baetzba huchsheru bemashke piv vesheal etzbao: 
Nashach baochel venafal haochel hare hammashke sheal haochel shello leratzon. haya ochel zetim petzuim utemarim retubbot vechol shehu rotze lamotz et garinato venafal mippiv hare hammashke shealav beratzon. haya ochel zetim neguvin utemarim yeveshot vechol sheeno rotze lamotz et garinato venafal mippiv hare hammashke shealav shello beratzon: 
Ulshin shellikketan livhema vehedichan vechishshev alehen leadam achar kach kevar bearnu shehen tzerichim hechsher sheni. veim haya alehen mashke tofeach keshechishshev alehen leadam hare ellu muchsharin:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 15:
Mayim shebbakkelim mittammein bin leratzon ben shello leratzon umetammein ochalim vechelim ben shennafal alehen beratzon ben shello nafal alehen beratzon. aval mayim shebbakkarkaot kegon me borot shichin umearot ume gevaim sheen bahem arbaim sea en mittammein ella leratzon veen metammein ella beratzon. ketzad. mayim shebbakkarka sheen bahen arbaim sea ben shehayu sheuvin ben sheenan sheuvin shennafal letochan hammet o shehalach bahen hattame hare ellu tehorin. aval im shata mehen adam tame o shemmille bahen bichli tame o shennaflu letochan mashkin temein beratzon hare ellu temein veaf al pi shehen bakkarka. shata mehen hattahor achar shennitmeu bakkarka o shemmille bahen bichli tahor nitma hashshote venitma hakkeli shehare beratzon shata o mille. nafal letochan kikkar shel teruma hare hu tahor keshehaya sheen mittammein ella leratzon. lefichach im hediach yado vehotzi hakkikkar nitma hakkikkar bammayim shebbeyadav shehare hen beratzon: 
Me gevaim vechayyotze bahen mimmayim shebbakkarkaot kegon me borot shichin umearot ume tamtzit sheppasku umikvaot sheen bahen arbaim sea shennitmeu veyardu lahem geshamim verabbu me geshamim alehem af al pi shello shatfu hare hen tehorin lefichach kol hammayim shebbakkarkaot kegon me gevaim vechayyotze bahen bishat haggeshamim hakkol bechezkat tohora: 
Pasku haggeshamim hakkerovim lair o ladderech temein shehen bechezkat sheshshata mehen hattame veshemmilleu mehen bechelim temein. veharchokim tehorim ad sheyyehallechu rov haadam. halchu hakkol bechezkat tuma shehaholchim bashshayyarot memallein veshotin mehen. bamme devarim amurim begeve sheefshar lishtot mimmenna. aval begeve shei efshar lishtot mimmenna ella bedochak gadol hare zo bechezkat tohora (shehen bechezkat tehorin) ad sheyyimtza mekom parsot ragle adam o parsot ragle behema gassa nikkeret bo aval matza parsot ragle behema dakka hare ze tahor sheefshar sheyyarda veshatat: 
Chezkat tit ugemumiyyot shebbefitche chanuyyot birshut harabbim bishat haggeshamim shehen tehorin. pasku haggeshamim hare hen keme shefichot. veshebbashshevakin holchin bahen achar harov. geve shennafal letocho yayin o chalav o devash holchin bo achar harov. nafal letocho shemen af al pi shehikpiahu hare ze mittamme umetamme shello beratzon lefi shei efshar lo latzet yede tzachtzachit: 
Shemen ushear hammashkin chutz min hammayim hare hen bakkarka kemot shehen bechelim din echad hu: 
Me tamtzit shello pasku af al pi sheen bahen arbaim sea hoil vehen bakkarka vahare hammayim nimshachin uvain lahen enan mekabbelin tuma. veaf al pi sheshshata mehen hattame umille mehen bichli tame o natan letochan mayim temeim hare hen tehorin lechol davar: 
Mi shehaya ochel teruma beyadayim temeot kegon devela shello huchshera vehichnis yado letoch piv littol tzeror im hafach nitmet haddevela beriro shehare nitma bayyad mippene sheakaro. veim lo hafach tehora shehammashke shebbefiv kodem sheyyehappechennu o yemotztzennu lehotzio dome lemayim shello nitleshu ella hen adayin bakkarka sheen mittammein veen metammein ella beratzon kemo shebbearnu. veze en retzono ella littol hatztzeror. haya punedyon letoch piv ufashat yado littelo vehaddevela betoch piv im hinnicho litzmao hare ze harok keakur venitmet haddevela mechamat mashke piv shennitma mechamat yadav: 
Haishsha shehayta ochelet ochalin shel teruma sheenan muchsharin vehayta gorefet et hattannur hattame vehikka hakkotz veyatza mimmenna dam umatztza etzbaah mippene haddam o shennichvet venatna etzbaah befiha nitmet hatteruma shebbefiha. shehare retzonah lehotzi hammashke mippiha uleakro bimtzitzat etzba:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement of Foods 16: Kol haaguddot shebbashshevakim vechol hakkemachim vechol hasselatot shebbashshevkim bechezkat muchsharin. haaguddot mippene sheddarkan lezallef hammayim alehen tamid vehakkemach vehassolet lottin oto veachar kach tochanin oto. vechen chittin shecholkin otan berechayim achat lishtayim veachat leshalosh kede laasot mehen maase kedera kegon harifot vechayyotze bahen hare hen bechezkat muchsharin bechol makom ben shel shevakin ben shel battim. mippene shellottin otan lehasir kelippatan:

Kol ellu shehen bechezkat muchsharin hare hen bechezkat tuma mippene shehakkol memashmeshin bahen vehen muchsharin. veal kullan neeman am haaretz lomar lo huchsheru veen tzarich lomar shear ochalin sheen lahen chazaka sheam haaretz neeman lomar lo huchsheru:

Kol haddagim bechezkat muchsharin veen am haaretz neeman alehen lomar lo huchsheru lefichach leolam haddagim bechezkat tuma. haddagim ben shetztzadan becherem ben bechafuf ben bimtzuda im lo nier et hammetzuda alehen lo huchsheru. veim nier huchsheru. veen am haaretz neeman lomar lo niarti et hammetzuda alehen vahare hen bechezkat tuma ad sheyyitkavven letzudan betohora:

Kol hatztzir bechezkat muchshar vtzir tahor shennafal letocho mayim kol shehem hare hakkol mashke umachshir umittamme tumat mashkin lefichach chezkato tame. nafal letocho yayin devash vechalav holchin achar harov. vechen me perot shennitarvu bishar hammashkin holchin achar harov. nitarvu bemayim kol shehen hare hakkol mashke umittamme tumat mashkin umachshir. vetzir chagavim temeim eno machshir aval mittamme tumat mashkin:

Hallokeach tzir meam haaretz mashshiko bammayim vetahor sheim haya rov hatztzir mayim hare hammayim mitaharin bemikve. veim haya rubbo melach shel dagim enah mekabbelet tuma vehammayim shebbah batlu bemiutan. bamme devarim amurim litbol bahen pat. aval likdera matza min et mino veneor venimtzeu rov hammayim temeim. shehammiut shehaya batztzir lo tahor bemikve:
Happerot bechol makom bechezkat tohora afillu haya hammocher akkum ad sheyyeda shehuchsheru o sheyyihyu middevarim shechezkatan muchsharin:
Haog bechol makom bechezkat tuma. vechen kol hakkishshuin vehaddeluin vehatteluyot begemi al pitche chanuyyot bechezkat muchsharin utemein:

Kol hakkatuv battora uvedivre kabbala mehilchot hattumot vehattohorot eno ella leinyan mikdash vekadashav uterumot umaaser sheni bilvad. shehare hizhir et hattemein millikkanes lammikdash o leechol kodesh o teruma umaaser betuma. aval hachullin en bahen issur kelal ella muttar leechol chullin temein velishtot mashkin temeim. hare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 7 19)</small> "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel". mikkelal shehachullin muttarin sheeno medabber ella bivsar kadashim. im ken mippene ma neemar harishon shebbechullin tame vehashsheni pasul lo sheyyihye asur baachila ella limnot mimmennu litruma ulekodesh sheim naga sheni shel chullin bitruma pesalah vaasaah shelishi. vechen im naga boochalin shel kodesh timmean vaasaan shelishi kemo shebbearnu. vechen haochel ochel sheni shel chullin im naga bitruma pesalah:

Keshem shemmuttar leechol chullin temeim velishtotan kach muttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael. veyesh lo letamme et hachullin hametukkanin lechattechilla. vechen muttar laadam ligga bechol hattumot ulehittamme bahen. shehare hizhir hakkatuv et bene aharon veet hannazir mehittamme bemet mikkelal shekkol haam muttarin. vesheaf kohanim unezirim muttarin lehittamme bishar tumot chutz mitteme met:

Kol yisrael muzharin lihyot tehorim bechol regel mippene shehem nechonim likkanes bammikdash veleechol kadashim. veze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 11 8)</small> "uvenivlatam lo tiggau" baregel bilvad veim nitma eno loke aval bishar yemot hashshana eno muzhar:

<small>(Devarim 12 22)</small> "hattame vehattahor yachdav" mippi hashshemua lamdu shehattame vehattahor ochlin bikara achat aval lo yochal habbaal im ishto bakkeara keshettihye nidda velo yishte immah velo timzog lo et hakkos kemo shebbearnu. velo yochal hazzav im hazzava mippene hergel avera shemma yivol:

Af al pi shemmuttar leechol ochalin temein velishtot mashkin temeim chasidim harishonim hayu ochlin chullin betohora venizharin min hattumot kullan kol yemehem vehen hannikraim perushim vedavar ze kedushsha yetera hi vederech chasidut sheyyihye nivdal adam uforesh mishshear haam velo yigga bahem velo yochal veyishte immahem. shehapperishut mevia lide tohorat hagguf mimmaasim haraim. vetohorat hagguf mevia lide kedushshat hannefesh min haddeot haraot. ukedushshat hannefesh goremet lehiddamot bashshechina. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 44, Vayikra 20, 6-7)</small> "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai mekaddishchem": berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 1:
Hazzorea shene mine zeraim keechad beeretz yisrael loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim": 
Veechad hazzorea o hamenakkesh o hamechappe kegon shehayta chitta achat useora achat o pol echad vaadasha achat munnachin al haaretz vechippa otan beafar ben beyado ben beraglo ben bichli hare ze loke. veechad hazzorea baaretz o beatzitz nakuv. aval hazzorea beatzitz sheeno nakuv makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Asur lizroa kilayim lenachri. umuttar lomar lenachri lizroa lo kile zeraim. veasur leadam lekayyem kile zeraim besadehu ella okran veim kiyyeman eno loke. umuttar leyisrael lizroa kile zeraim beyado bechutza laaretz vaafillu learev hazzeraim lechattechilla ulezaran bechutza laaretz muttar udevarim ellu divre kabbala: 
En asur mishshum kile zeraim ella hazzeraim haruyin lemaachal adam. aval asavim hammarim vechayyotze bahen min haikkarin sheenan reuyin ella lirfua vechayyotze bahen en bahen mishshum kile zeraim: 
Kile hailanot hare hem bichlal ma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim". ketzad. hammarkiv ilan bailan kegon shehirkiv yichur shel tappuach beetrog o etrog betappuach hare ze loke min hattora bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. vechen hammarkiv yarak beilan o ilan beyarak loke bechol makom: 
Veasur leyisrael lehaniach lenachri sheyyarkiv lo ilanot kilayim. umuttar lizroa zeraim vezera ilan keechad vechen muttar learev zare ilanot ulezaran keechad sheen lecha kilayim bailanot ella harekava bilvad: 
Hazzorea zeraim kilayim vechen hammarkiv ilanot kilayim af al pi shehu loke hare ellu muttarin baachila vaafillu laze sheavar uzeraan shello neesar ella zeriatan bilvad. umuttar litta yichur min hailan shehurkav kilayim velizroa mizzera hayyarak shennizra kilayim: 
Hazzeronin nechelakin lishlosha chalakim. haechad mehem hu hannikra tevua vehi chamishsha minin hachittim vehakkussemin vehasseorin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon. vehashsheni mehen hu hannikra kitnit. vehen kol zeraim hanneechol leadam chutz min hattevua. kegon happol vehaafunim vehaadashim vehaddochan vehaorez vehashshumshemin vehapperagin vehassappir vechayyotze bahen. vehashshelishi mehen hu hannikra zerone ginna. vehen shear zeronin sheenan reuyin lemaachal adam. vehapperi shel oto hazzera maachal adam. kegon zera habbetzalim vehashshumin vezera hechatzir vehakketzach vezera lefet vechayyotze bahen. vezera pishtan hare hu bichlal zerone ginna. kesheyyizaru kol mine zeronim ellu veyitzmechu nikra hatztzemach kullo kol zeman shello nikkar hazzera deshe venikra yerek: 
Veyesh mizzerone ginna zeronim sheddarkan lizroa mehen sadot kegon happishtan vehachardal veellu hen hannikraim mine zeraim. veyesh mizzerone ginna zeronim sheen derech bene adam lizroa mehem ella arugot arugot ketannot kegon hallefet vehatztzenon vehatteradim vehabbetzalim vehakkusbar vehakkarpas vehammaror vechayyotze bahen veellu hen hannikraim mine yerakot:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 2:
Zera shennitarev bo zera acher im hayu echad meesrim vearbaa kegon sea shel chittim shennitarva beesrim veshalosh sea shel seorim hare ze asur lizroa et hameorav ad sheyyemaet et hachittin o yosif al hasseorim veim zara loke: 
Vechol shehu kilayim im hazzera mitztaref leechad meesrim vearba. ketzad. esrim veshalosh sea shel chittim shennitarev bah shene kabbin seorim ushene kabbin adashim ushene kabbin polim hare ze lo yizra hakkol ad sheyyemaet sea shel taarovet veyavor miktzatah o yosif al hachittim. shehasseorim vehaadashim vehappol kullam kilayim im hachittim: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshennitarvu mine tevua ze baze o mine kitniyyot ze baze o shennitarva tevua bekitniyyot o kitniyyot bitvua. aval zerone ginna shennitarev echad mehen bitvua o bekitniyyot shiuran echad meesrim vearbaa mimma shezzorin bevet sea meoto hammin im nitarev bisa shel tevua o kitnit lo yizra ad sheyyemaet o yosif al hattevua: 
Ketzad. chardal shennitarev bitvua vahare hachardal zorin mimmennu kav bechol bet sea im nitarev mimmennu echad meesrim vearbaa min hakkav bisa shel tevua o shel kitnit chayyav lemaet. vechen im haya min ze mizzerone ginna zorin mimmennu satayim bechol bet sea im nitarev mimmennu chatzi kav bechol sea shel tevua o shel kitnit yemaet: 
Lefichach tevua shennitarev bah zera pishtan im haya sheloshet reviim bechol sea hare ze yemaet. veim lav eno tzarich lemaet. lefi shebbet sea zorin bo shalosh seim zera pishtan. veal derech ze meshaarim bechol hazzeraim haacherim: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshello nitkavven learev uveshello nitkavven lizroa hashshene minin shennitarvu. aval im nitkavven learev zera bezera acher o lizroa hashshene minin afillu hayta chitta achat betoch keri shel seorim asura lezarah. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hazzorea sadehu min min hamminin uchesheyyitzmach raa bo kilayim. im haya hammin haechad echad meesrim vearbaa bassade hare ze yilkot ad sheyyemaatennu mippene marit haayin. shemma yomru kilayim zara bechavvana. ben shehaya hammin haechad shetztzamach tevua vekitnit bitvua vekitnit. o zerone ginna bitvua vekitnit uvezerone ginna. veim haya hatztzomeach pachot mikkan eno tzarich lemaato: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyesh makom lachashad. aval bizman shehaddevarim marin sheen ze middato shel baal hassade ella mealehen alu en mechayyevin oto lemaet: 
Ketzad. kegon tevua shealu bah sefiche istis vetiltan shezzeraah lemaachal adam shealu bah mine asavim shezze mafsid hu. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Uvema yivvada shehattiltan zerua lemaachal adam. keshehayta zerua arugot arugot velah gevul saviv. vechen mekom haggoranot shealu bah minin harebe en mechayyevin oto laakor. shehare haddavar yadua sheeno rotze sheyyitzmach tzemach bimkom haggoranot. veim hesir miktzatan omrin lo akor hakkol chutz mimmin echad shehare gilla dato sherotze bekiyyum hashshear: 
En notin yerakot betoch saddan shel shikma vechayyotze bah. hattomen aguddat lefet utzenon vechayyotze bah tachat hailan afillu tachat haggefen. im hayu miktzat healin megullin eno choshesh shehare eno rotze behasherashatan veim enan agudda o shello hayu healin megullin choshesh mishshum kilayim: 
Sade shehayta zerua vekatzar hazzera venisharu haikkarin baaretz af al pi sheen motziin tzemach ella achar kamma shanim lo yihye zorea beotah sade min acher ad sheyyaakor haikkarin: 
Hayta sadehu zerua chittim venimlach lezarah seorim kodem sheyyitzmechu hachittim. yamtin lah ad sheyyippasdu hachittim veyatliu baaretz kemo shelosha yamim im hayta sadehu rava veachar kach yehappecheha bemachresha veyizra hammin haacher. veeno tzarich lehappech et kullah ad shello tishshaer chitta shello neekra ella choresh et hassade kederech shechorshin otah kodem hammatar kede shettirve: 
Tzamchu hachittim veachar kach nimlach lezarah seorim yahafoch veachar kach yizra. veim horid behemto letochah vekirsema et hatztzemach hare ze muttar lizroa sham min acher: 
Beechad baadar mashmiin al hakkilayim. vechol adam yotze leginnato ulesadehu umenakkin oto min hakkilayim. uvachamishsha asar bo yotzim sheluche bet din umesabbevim livdok: 
Barishona hayu okrin umashlichin vehayu baale battim semechim shemmenakkin lahen sedotehen. hitkinu sheyyihyu mafkirin et kol hassade sheyyimtzeu bo kilayim. vehu sheyyimtzeu bah min acher echad mearbaa veesrim aval pachot mikkan lo yiggeu bah: 
Vechozrin sheluche bet din bechullo shel moed happesach lirot haafil sheyyatza. vechilayim shehenetztzu en mamtinim lahen ella yotzin alehen miyyad umafkirin et kol hassade im yesh bah echad meesrim vearbaa:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 3:
Yesh minin bazzerain sheyyihye hammin haechad nifrad letzurot harebe mippene shinnuy mekomot vehaavoda sheovdin haaretz ad sheyyerae kishne minin veaf al pi sheen domin ze laze hoil vehen min echad enan kilayim ze baze: 
Veyesh bazzeraim shene minin shehen domin ze laze vetzurat shenehen kerova lihyot tzura achat veaf al pi chen hoil vehen shene minin hare ellu asurim ze im ze: 
Ketzad. hachazeret im chazeret gallim. vehaelshin im elshe sade. vehakkereshin im kereshe sade. hakkusbar im kusbar harim. vechardal im chardal mitzri. udelaat hammitzrit im delaat harmutza enan kilayim ze baze. vechen hachittin im hazzunin. vehasseorim im shibbolet shual. vehakkussemin im hashshifon. vehappol im hassappir. vehappurkedan im hattofach. ufol lavan im hashsheuim. vehakkeshut im hammelaffon. vehakkeruv im hatterovtor. vehatteradin im halleunin enan kilayim ze im ze. aval hatztzenon im hannefusin. vehachardal im hallafsan. udelaat yevanit im delaat mitzrit o im delaat harmutza af al pi sheddomim ze laze hare ellu kilayim ze baze: 
Vechen beilan sheyyesh shene minin sheddomin ze laze baalin o bapperot hoil vehen shene minin hare ellu kilayim. ketzad. hattappuach im hachizrad. vehapparsekin im hashshekedim. vehashshezafin im harimin af al pi sheddomin ze laze hare hen kilayim ze baze. aval haagassim im hakerusetmalim vehapperishim im haezradin enan kilayim ze baze: 
Vechen im yesh sham zeraim veilanot acherot af al pi shehen shene minin betivan hoil vealin shel ze domin lealin shel ze o peri shel ze dome lifri shel ze dimyon gadol ad sheyyerau kishne gevanin mimmin echad lo chashshu lahen lechilayim ze im ze sheen holchin bechilayim ella achar marit haayin: 
Ketzad. hallefet im hatztzenon enan kilayim ze baze mippene sheppiryehen shavin. vehallefet im hannefus enan kilayim ze baze mippene shehealin shellahen shavin. aval tzenon im hannefus af al pi shehealin domin ze laze vehapperi dome lapperi hare ellu kilayim hoil vetaam peri ze rachok mittaam peri ze beyoter. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Kamma marchikin ben shene mine zeraim shehen kilayim ze im ze. kede sheyyihyu nirim muvdalin ze mizze. aval im nirin shennizreu beirbuveya hare ze asur: 
Veshiurin rabbim yesh beharechaka hazzot hakkol lefi godel hassade hannizraat ulefi rov healin veshilluach hayyonkot: 
Ketzad. sadehu shehayta zerua min tevua uvikkesh lizroa betziddah min tevua acheret besade achat marchik benehen bet rova vehu keeser ammot vechomesh amma al eser ammot vechomesh amma merubba ben min haemtza ben min hatztzad. veim lo haya benehen kashshiur hazze asur veeno loke ad sheyyihyu kerovin betoch shishsha tefachim: 
Hayta sadehu zerua yarak uvikkesh lizroa betziddah sede yarak acher afillu delaat marchik ben shete hassadot shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim merubba ben min hatztzad ben min haemtza. ufachot mishshiur ze asur veeno loke ad sheyyihyu kerovin betoch tefach: 
Hayta achat mishshete hassadot zerua tevua vehashsheniyya shebbetziddah yarak o delaat marchik benehen bet rova: 
Bamme devarim amurim shetztzarich leharechaka bashshiurin hallalu ben shete sadot. aval im hayta sadehu zerua yarak veratza lizroa betziddah shura shel yarak mimmin acher dayyo laasot ben hassade uven hashshura telem echad arko shishsha tefachim bilvad verachbo keamko: 
Hayta sadehu zerua tevua veratza lizroa betochah shura shel yarak afillu shura shel deluin shealin shellahen arukkim umistabbechin marchik benehen shishsha tefachim. veim nimshechu healim shel delaat venichnesu lattevua venistabbechu bah yaakor min hattevua shellifne haddelaat ad shello yitarvu healin. veen tzarich lomar sheim zara shura mimmin ze veshura mimmin acher sheddayyo lihyot benehen telem echad kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hirchik ben shene hamminin harechaka haruya lahen vehaya min ze note al gabbe min ze ben shennatta tevua al hattevua o yarak al gabbe yarak o yarak al hattevua o tevua al hayyarak hakkol muttar. shehare hirchik kashshiur. chutz middelaat yevanit shehi nimshechet harebe. lefichach im natta yaakor millefaneha kemo shebbearnu: 
Haya ben shene hamminim bor o nir o gappa o derech o gader shehu gavoah asara tefachim o charitz shehu amok asara tefachim verachav arbaa. o ilan shehu mesech al haaretz. o sela shehu gavoah asara tefachim verachav arbaa. hare ze muttar lismoch hammin haechad letzad echad meellu vehammin haacher latztzad hashsheni hoil veechad mikkol ellu mavdil benehen hare hen nirim muvdalin ze mizze: 
Bamme devarim amurim shetztzarich harechaka o davar hammavdil beshezzara betoch sadehu. aval im hayta sadehu zerua chittim muttar lachavero lizroa betziddah seorim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim". en haissur ella sheyyizra sadehu kilayim shello neemar haaretz lo tizra kilayim. velo od ella afillu zara betoch sadehu seorim samuch lachittim umashach zera hasseorim ad shessemacho lisde chavero shehi zerua seorim hare ze muttar. mippene shenniru hasseorim shebbetoch sadehu shehen sof sede chavero: 
Hayta sadehu zerua chittim usede chavero betziddah zerua chittim muttar lo lizroa telem echad shel pishtan betzad chittim shello samuch lisde chavero. sheharoe yodea sheen derech haam lizroa telem echad shel pishtan velo nitkavven ze ella livdok sadehu im reuya hi lizroa pishtan im lo venimtza kezorea lehashechata. lefichach asur lizroa min acher ben shete shurot ellu shehen mimmin echad ad sheyyarchik betoch shello:
